title: Lipschitzian SLLNs for random functions
abstract: arXiv:2607.20411v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We prove strong laws of large numbers for random functions in the Lipschitz pseudometric. Our results hold under either a topological or a model-theoretic condition, with the latter encompassing functions jointly definable in o-minimal structures but extending substantially beyond this class. Applications include uniform convergence of limiting and Clarke subdifferentials and finite-sample identification of solutions. Consequently, we identify broad classes of functions for which the failure phenomena revealed by our previous negative results [Tian and Royset, arXiv:2511.16568, 2025] do not occur.

translated_title: 随机函数的Lipschitz强大数定律
translated_abstract: 我们证明了随机函数在Lipschitz伪度量下的强大数定律。我们的结果在一个拓扑条件或一个模型论条件下均成立，其中后者涵盖了可在o-极小结构中联合定义的函数，但其实际适用范围大大超出了这一类函数。应用包括极限次微分与Clarke次微分的一致收敛性，以及解的有限样本辨识。由此，我们识别出了广泛的函数类，使得我们先前的负面结果[Tian and Royset, arXiv:2511.16568, 2025]所揭示的失效现象在这些函数类上不会发生。
tldr: 本文证明了随机函数在Lipschitz伪度量下的强大数定律，其条件涵盖o-极小结构可定义函数等广泛函数类，从而保证了次微分的一致收敛与解的有限样本辨识，并识别出先前负面结果所揭示的失效现象不会发生的函数类。
en_tdlr: This paper proves strong laws of large numbers for random functions in the Lipschitz pseudometric under topological or model-theoretic conditions, enabling uniform convergence of limiting and Clarke subdifferentials and finite-sample identification of solutions, and identifying broad function classes where previously revealed failure phenomena do not occur.
